disclaimer: Synthetic data — research demonstration only. All case records and climate scenarios are artificially generated. They are not Tamil Nadu surveillance data, climate projections or forecasts, and must not be used for clinical decisions or public-health alerts.

recovery_rule.threshold_definition: 1.2 × median of cases in the same calendar month, 2015–2021 (baseline, observed)
recovery_rule.tsr_definition: Months from the reference peak t0 to the first month of the first run of 3 consecutive months at or below the threshold
recovery_rule.interruption_definition: After at least one month of decline, cases rise above the threshold and to ≥ 1.2 × the latest low for 2 consecutive months

masks.label: 10% random gaps
masks.description: 10% of case months removed at random

masks.label: 9-month reporting outage
masks.description: Cases missing Jan–Sep 2023 (exceeds the 30% missing limit by design)

limitations: All values are synthetic; district populations and climatologies are illustrative, not real figures.
Disease climate-response curves are modelling assumptions marked 'to be sourced'; results follow from them.
Warming shortens recovery here only because the districts are warmer than the assumed temperature optimums.
Endemic thresholds are estimated from only 7 training years (2015–2021).
Recovery rules (1.2 × median threshold, 3-month window, interruption rule) are project conventions, not epidemiological standards.
Series that never recover by Dec 2024 are censored: their recovery time is a lower bound, not a value.
The estimated reference peak (t0) differs from the true t0 in some series.
Flood exposure and intervention profiles are recorded but not used by generator v0.1.0.
The implemented dataset departs from the written plan in climate variables, threshold method and disease choice.
